lines: The government recently released a statement lauding the performance of the SK 5204 television set from Aijin Industrial, boasting about it being a trailblazer in its field, built to last with sturdy material, and incomparable with its Western counterparts, out-selling similar products.

A small problem that they failed to mention was that it still uses technology from 15 years ago, built with wood and metal instead of lighter materials, so the only way it 'outsold similar products' is by comparing the total weights.
